data.one_liner: Mediation adapter for Unity Ads to work with the google_mobile_ads Flutter plugin
data.what_it_does: It bridges the Unity Ad Network with the Google Mobile Ads SDK, allowing Unity ads to be requested and served through the standard google_mobile_ads API. The plugin handles platform-specific integration for Android and iOS.
use_when: You already use google_mobile_ads and want to add Unity Ads as a mediation partner
You need to serve ads from Unity while keeping a single ad SDK in your app
avoid_when: You are not using google_mobile_ads or you do not need Unity Ads
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS adapters
Keeps Unity integration up to date with the latest Unity adapter versions
weaknesses: Requires keeping the plugin in sync with the Google Mobile Ads Flutter plugin
data.setup_notes: Add gma_mediation_unity to pubspec, run flutter pub get, then configure Unity Ads in your app as per the Unity Ads developer guide. No build_runner needed.
